blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Land Transportation Office (LTO) on Monday reminded drivers and operators of public utility vehicles (PUVs) to ensure their units are roadworthy and comply with regulatory requirements ahead of the expected influx of passengers during All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day, or Undas. The LTO conducted roadworthiness inspections at terminals in Metro Manila. LTO Director II Allan Nobleza said that during the inspections, one driver tested positive for illegal drugs, while no one tested positive on the alcohol breath analyzer.
